entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: Manju Rani Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2761 of 2021
Applicant :- Sufiyan Khan And 7 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Gopal Krishna Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
List revised.
No one has appeared on behalf of the applicants to press this application.
Mr. Pankaj Srivastava, learned A.G.A. for the State is present.

The applicants have filed present application invoking the powers of Section 438 Cr.P.C. stating therein that they reasonably apprehend their arrest by the police for having committed a non-bailable offence registered as Case Crime No.0199 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3, 4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station-Mahila Thana, District-Muzaffar Nagar.
Perusal of the record goes to show that on 12.02.2021 protection was granted to the applicants.

Learned A.G.A. points out that the applicants have approached this Court directly without approaching the Session Judge, which is not in consonance of Judgement rendered in the case of Ankit Bharti vs. State of U.P. & Another.

entities.text:
Ankit Bharti vs. State of U.P. & Another.
Sufiyan Khan And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A Full Bench of this Court in the case of Ankit Bharti and others v. State of U.P. and another, 2020 (3) ADJ 575 (FB), has clearly held that special circumstances must necessarily exist and be established, and the application must rest on a strong foundation to invoke concurrent jurisdiction of this Court directly; without rejection by the court below.

entities.text: Ankit Bharti and others v. State of U.P. and another, 2020 (3) ADJ 575 (FB)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances, I find that the reasons assigned for approaching this Court directly for anticipatory bail are not at all convincing extraordinary and special, as such, this anticipatory bail application is rejected leaving it open to the applicants to take recourse to the remedy available under law.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
It is open to the Court/authority concerned to proceed in accordance with law.
Registrar (Compliance) is directed to inform about this order to the concerned Court/authority for necessary information and compliance, forthwith.
Order Date :- 19.1.2023 Rahul.
